pages.text: The Queen of Blades, in the head of the leviathan high in the stratosphere over the zerg lair.

Leaping strike and psionic shift. At 2/3 health she calls her brood (zerglings, a hydralisk, a roach) and her shields come back; at 1/3 she rages for the rest of the fight and calls more. Her bar shows the phase.$(br2)$(l)When beaten$() Amun's hold breaks and the hero joins you (see Amun's Hold), leaving: Kerrigan's Crown, the rest of a zerg suit, 16 chitin shards, 8 diamonds.
